description: What the model says, read out rather than scored: at the last token of each prompt, the three tokens it finds most likely, decoded, each with its probability — a list per row, which its table writes as the row's value. Beside it, the probability of the expected answer spelled bare, as the first word of a text is, rather than after a space: a column's text is tokenized exactly as written, so the rows here write the answer without its space.

rows.input: If today is Thursday, tomorrow is
If today is Friday, tomorrow is
If today is Saturday, tomorrow is
If today is Sunday, tomorrow is
